why: There is no drafts screen. Pass 1 enumerated it from a routing table that still lists routes the application stopped serving; src/screens/drafts.jsx does not exist and nothing imports it.
There is no labels screen either, and for the same reason: the same stale routing table. src/screens/labels.jsx does not exist and label management happens inline in the thread header instead.

The daily digest is an email template rendered server-side, not a screen in this application. It has no path in this repository for the engine to check, so this claim is recorded unverified on purpose.

set.detail: Compose autosaves, but the interface never says so, and there is no drafts screen to go and look — that route was enumerated in pass 1 and turned out not to exist. So the reader has no way to distinguish work that is safe from work that is about to be lost, and no second place to check. That is the single highest-stakes uncertainty on the screen.

why: The phantom finding about drafts changes what this finding means: the missing reassurance is not merely quiet, it is the only signal that exists.
